title: Finite type preserved by epimorphic images
statement: For any sheaf of rings R and epimorphism e : A ⟶ B of sheaves of R-modules, if A is of finite type then B is of finite type.

proof.text: Obtain finite local-generators data for A. On each over-site object in its covering, the restriction of e is epi by the over-functor epi lemma. Apply GeneratingSections.ofEpi to each finite generating family; the same finite index type remains. Assemble these families with the original covering data to obtain finite local-generators data for B.
